core_obligations: Note F is additive, exact, colimit- and direct-sum-commuting; take U ⊂ X affine with Z = X \ U cut out by a finite type ideal I.
F(O_X/I) has support T ⊂ Y with V = Y \ T quasi-compact open; supported-on-support gives the equivalence of the two support subcategories.
Use quotient-supported-on-closed for the commuting square, characterize-affine for V affine, and functor-equivalence for f_U : V → U and L_U.
Record the omitted glueing of the f_U and L_U over affine inclusions (assembly-level residual).
